en.headline: Yuen Long market lane hangs handmade lanterns ahead of Mid-Autumn
en.dek: The incense shop Koon Heung Hong again lines a passage inside Tai Kiu Market with hand-tied lanterns in the weeks before the festival on 25 September.
body: A narrow passage inside Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long has again been hung with handmade lanterns as Mid-Autumn Festival approaches on 25 September, continuing an annual display by the incense shop Koon Heung Hong.

The shop, which opened in 1984 at 2 Kiu Lok Square, strings traditional hand-tied lanterns across the market lane each year in the run-up to the festival. Past seasons have featured animals, fruit, vehicles and other shapes in paper, cellophane and fabric. This year's festival falls on Friday 25 September, with the following day a general holiday.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Hong Kong Tourism Board are separately staging lantern displays at Victoria Park from 17 September. The Yuen Long lane is a neighbourhood stall display rather than an official carnival, and visitors typically come to look at or buy lanterns before the holiday.

Tai Kiu Market is about a seven-minute walk from Long Ping MTR station Exit D. Shop hours in previous years have been listed as 8am to 8pm; anyone planning a visit should check on the day as the stall is a working shop.

zh.headline: 中秋將至 元朗大橋街市再掛手紮燈籠
zh.dek: 大橋街市內香燭店冠香行按年在巷內掛起手紮燈籠，中秋正日為9月25日，翌日為公眾假期。
body: 中秋節將於9月25日到來，元朗大橋街市一條窄巷再次掛滿手紮燈籠，由1984年開業的香燭店冠香行按年在節前佈置。
店舖位於元朗橋樂坊2號，往年會在街市通道掛上動物、水果、交通工具等不同造型的傳統燈籠，物料包括皺紙、玻璃紙及布料。今年中秋正日為9月25日星期五，翌日為公眾假期。
康樂及文化事務署與旅遊發展局另外由9月17日起在維園舉辦綵燈活動。元朗這條巷是舖戶應節擺設，並非官方綵燈會，街坊多在節前來看燈或選購燈籠。
大橋街市由港鐵朗屏站D出口步行約7分鐘可達。店舖往年營業時間為上午8時至晚上8時，實際開放須以當日為準。
